images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of AgenticRoboRL.(a) Agentic robotics systems combine planners with robot harnesses for multi-turn interaction with the environment. (b) We post-train planners through SFT on successful trajectories followed by multi-turn RL. (c) On LIBERO-PRO, post-training improves a 9B planner’s success rate from 18.1% to 71.0%, approaching the 72.1% achieved by Codex (GPT-5.5)with memory. Mem denotes external memory.

Figure 2:AgenticRoboRL training pipeline.(a) Successful trajectories are converted into training examples for SFT. (b) The planner interacts with the environment through a robot harness, while a proxy records its model calls. (c) Recorded calls are matched with episode outcomes for RL updates, excluding episodes invalidated by infrastructure failures. Harness-specific adapters support a common training pipeline across different harnesses. Only the planner is trained; execution components remain fixed.
